subject: Geo segmentation Q&A + VPC runbook request for EU-only pilot
messages:
From: Liz Carpenter <liz.carpenter@medisys-health.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: tim.kavanaugh@medisys-health.com, supply@medisys-health.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Geo segmentation Q&A + runbook for EU-only pilot

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the quick demo last week. We're moving toward a small EU-only pilot and procurement has asked for a concise set of confirmations so we can complete legal and network approvals. High level asks below — can your team confirm or provide an ops runbook for each? I've attached our target VPC diagram and a Word doc with the questions.

1) Are we able to enforce strict routing such that all inference traffic for the MediSys EU tenant terminates in your EU region and never egresses to the US under normal operation?
2) What are the documented fallback behaviors (and auditory triggers) if EU capacity is exhausted — is there an automated failover to US, and can that be disabled?
3) For private deployments: do you support dedicated VPC peering + Cloud Interconnect, and do you provide per-tenant route maps so we can audit exact network paths?
4) KMS/key residency: can customer-managed keys be provisioned in our EU KMS and kept within the EU?
5) Network controls: do you support route table prefix filtering, source-based routing, and egress filtering at the peering boundary?

Tim (cc'd) will be the network owner for the pilot — he may send a short follow-up with CIDR and BGP details. We need these items for our SIG/SOC2 evidence pack and to complete a procurement statement of work.

Can you aim to share an internal runbook or a short evidence PDF by end of week? If you need an intro to our procurement team, say the word.

Thanks,

Liz Carpenter
VP, Digital Platforms
MediSys Health

Attachments: medisys-vpc-diagram-v1.pdf (1 page), requested-questionnaire-snapshot.docx (1 file)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Liz Carpenter <liz.carpenter@medisys-health.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, tim.kavanaugh@medisys-health.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 12:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Geo segmentation Q&A + runbook for EU-only pilot

Liz — thanks for the clear list. Quick summary and next steps below; we'll assemble a short runbook and evidence bundle.

TL;DR answers:
- EU termination: Yes — for our EU private deployment option we can keep primary inference execution and KV cache within EU-hosted infra.
- Failover behavior: Default platform policy is "regional fallback" (EU -> nearest compatible region) when capacity is unavailable, but that is configurable per-tenant and can be disabled for the pilot.
- Private connectivity: We support VPC peering and direct interconnect (Cloud Interconnect / Direct Connect equivalents). Per-tenant route maps and BGP session details are supported.
- KMS: We support customer-managed keys (BYOK) in customer KMS; keys and key material can be kept in EU KMS providers — we also provide an HSM-backed option for on-prem key escrow if needed.
- Network controls: Route prefix filtering and source-based ACLs are supported at the peering edge; we can also push an egress-policy manifest to your routing team to enforce deny-by-default.

Action items:
1) Marissa will draft the runbook + packet with sample route maps and a short SOC2-friendly statement of control.
2) Irene will pull our KMS keyflow diagram and a short note on BYOK limitations (rotation, signing for telemetry).
3) Tim, if you can share the CIDRs and whether you plan to use BGP or static routes, we'll include the exact BGP neighborhood config.

I'll attach a short checklist and the expected timeline (target: draft packet by Fri 2027-07-02). If procurement needs a formal SOW clause to disable cross-region failover, we can include it as an addendum.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, Liz Carpenter <liz.carpenter@medisys-health.com>, tim.kavanaugh@medisys-health.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 08:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Geo segmentation Q&A + runbook for EU-only pilot

Liz/Team — looping in the infra/ops artifacts. See answers and attached runbook excerpts below. I kept these short for procurement; we can expand on any item.

Attached: redwood-eu-private-runbook-v1.pdf (selection), sample-bgp-conf.txt (snippet)

Key excerpts:
- "Regional residency enforcement": for Dedicated/Private deployments, we implement VPC endpoint mapping plus a per-tenant placement tag. All inference worker instances assigned to the MediSys EU tenant are scheduled only on EU-hosted pools; KV caches are colocated.
- "Failover configuration": there are three modes — strict (no cross-region failover), manual (operator-triggered cross-region migration), and default (automated fallback). For the pilot we recommend strict, with a documented manual runbook for operator-initiated fallback.
- "Peering controls": we publish a per-tenant route manifest (JSON) that lists allowed prefixes. Our peering gateway enforces longest-prefix-match and rejects any advertisement that would route tokens outside EU. We support prefix-lists, community tagging for BGP, and route-targets for multi-tenant isolation.
- "KMS": BYOK is supported. When customers choose to BYOK from an EU KMS, the wrapping keys and HSM material never leave the EU. We require an initial trust setup window to exchange key fingerprints and a brief live check during onboarding.

Next steps:
- Irene: can you attach the KMS flow diagram and the required attestation language?
- Tim: confirm whether you'll run BGP session (we'll provide sample ASNs).

Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: redwood-eu-private-runbook-v1.pdf (4 pages), sample-bgp-conf.txt (snippet)

From: irene_choi@redwood.com <irene_choi@redwood.com>

Cc: Liz Carpenter <liz.carpenter@medisys-health.com>, tim.kavanaugh@medisys-health.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Geo segmentation Q&A + runbook for EU-only pilot

Adding the KMS and compliance blurb below (pulling a short extract from our SOC2/SIG packet) — happy to expand for an evidence PDF.

KMS excerpt:
- "Key residency and control": Redwood supports customer-managed keys in supported cloud KMS providers (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault). For EU-only pilots we require the customer KMS region to be in an EU jurisdiction. Wrapped keys are exchanged via secure KMS-agreement handshake and are not exported by Redwood.
- "Telemetry and signing": telemetry that helps routing/rebalance decisions carries only non-sensitive, cryptographic hashes; any signing operations using customer keys are performed in-region.
- "Audit trail": we maintain an immutable audit log of all key-handling operations for the tenant; logs can be shipped to customer-controlled log bucket in the EU on request.

Evidence items we can produce: SOC2 control excerpts, CAIQ answers for network isolation, a short attestation letter for in-region key residency, and a sample per-tenant route-manifest.

I'll attach: kms-flow-eu.pdf, soc2-controls-excerpt.pdf, per-tenant-route-manifest.json (sample).

Irene Choi
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

I'll monitor the JIRA you opened and will share the CIDR file via the secure drive link.

—Tim
